question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

One who makes an active effort to promote human welfare
solution:
The solution is **Philanthropist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The option that can be used as a one-word substitute for " One who makes an active effort to promote human welfare." is Philanthropist.
 
• Philanthropist - A person who seeks to promote the welfare of others, especially by the generous donation of money to good causes.
 
• *For example : "The trust was founded by an American philanthropist."*
 
• Therefore **option 1 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss information about other options :
 
• **Philosopher - **A person engaged or learned in philosophy, especially as an academic discipline.​
 
 
• ​​*For example : " Sam was a philosopher."*
 
 
 
• Philanderer - A man who readily or frequently enters into casual sexual relationships with women; a womanizer.
 
 
• ​*For example : "He was known as a philanderer."*
 
 
 
• Physicist - An expert in or student of physics.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• ​*For example : "Ram choose to become a physicist."*
